task: Read your own build errors from the shared loop (`/root/loop.sh`) as a lane
do: `ix shell lanebase-1112 --noninteractive -- bash -c "/root/loop.sh <branch> <cmd> >/tmp/x.out 2>&1; cp /root/loop-build.log /tmp/x-build.log; head -3 /tmp/x.out; grep -nE '^error' -A18 /tmp/x-build.log | head -200"`: the copy is taken in the same call, right after the lock is released, and the errors are grepped from it.
why: loop.sh prints `grep -E '^(error|warning: unused)' -A12 | head -150`, and cargo's `unused_workspace_dependencies` warnings (which start `warning: unused`) fill the 150 lines before the first error; and /root/loop-build.log is overwritten by the next lane's call.
